notes: Big one: math classroom content now runs in its own sandboxed plugin UI (real teacher dashboard + student answer UI, both moved out of Sotrice's own app code). A real cross-device join fix so a joining student gets their own dashboard, not a copy of the teacher's. Two new question types (multi-select, matching-pair with drag-and-drop) with a real authoring UI for both. A 2D/3D graphing plugin. Math Plugin now installs itself automatically on a fresh install. A real sotrice:// join link with a copy-link button on the teacher dashboard, plus a LaMa worksheet PDF upload UI. Also: minimap double-click swaps the 2D/3D view, smoother minimap resizing, F11 no longer forces presentation mode, an auto-clear-canvas setting, and Settings reorganized into tabs.
